description: This file defines an interface `FineractEntityAccessReadService` that provides methods for retrieving entity access information, mapping data, and SQL query generation related to entity relationships within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: FineractEntityAccessReadService
classes.description: An interface defining methods to read and retrieve entity access and mapping information within the Fineract infrastructure.

methods.name: retrieveEntityAccessFor
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of entity-to-entity mapping data for a given entity type and relationship ID, with options to include sub-offices.

methods.name: getSQLQueryInClause_WithListOfIDsForEntityAccess
methods.description: Generates an SQL 'IN' clause string for entity access based on entity type, relationship ID, entity ID, and inclusion of all offices.

methods.name: getSQLQueryInClauseIDList_ForLoanProductsForOffice
methods.description: Generates an SQL 'IN' clause string for loan products associated with a specific office.

methods.name: getSQLQueryInClauseIDList_ForSavingsProductsForOffice
methods.description: Generates an SQL 'IN' clause string for savings products associated with a specific office.

methods.name: getSQLQueryInClauseIDList_ForChargesForOffice
methods.description: Generates an SQL 'IN' clause string for charges associated with a specific office.

methods.name: retrieveAllSupportedMappingTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all supported entity relation mappings.

methods.name: retrieveOneMapping
methods.description: Retrieves mapping data for a specific mapping ID.

methods.name: retrieveEntityToEntityMappings
methods.description: Retrieves entity-to-entity mappings for specified mapping and entity IDs.
